1. Essential Qualifications
for the post of
Assistant Professor
1.10.Computer Science
(MCA)
Essential Qualifications:
a) B.E. / B. Tech. / B.S. and M.E. / M. Tech. / M.S. or Integrated M.
Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering / Information Technology
with first class or equivalent in any one of the degrees.
OR
b) Graduation of Three years duration with Mathematics as a
compulsory subject and MCA with first class or equivalent with two
years of the relevant experience after acquiring the degree of MCA and
with UGC NET/ AP-SLET/ AP-SET or Ph.D. in Computer
Applications / Computer Science.
Provided, the candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to
July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing
Ordinances/Bye-Laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the
degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the
requirement of NET/AP-SLET/AP-SET for recruitment and
appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in
Universities/Colleges/Institutions subject to the fulfilment of the
following conditions:
a) The Ph.D. degree of the candidate has been awarded in a
regular mode;
b) The Ph.D. thesis has been evaluated by at least two external
examiners;

1.17 History
Subject : Archaeology
Essential Qualifications:
A. (i) A Master’s degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-
scale wherever the grading system is followed) in History from an Indian
University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university.
Essential Qualifications:

4. Essential and Desired
Qualifications for the
post of Assistant
Professor
1.26.Pharmaceutical
Sciences
Essential Qualification :
(i)A first Class B.Pharm with Master’s degree in Pharmacy (M.Pharm) in
appropriate branch of specialization in Pharmacy (Qualifications must be PCI
recognized).
ii) A PCI recognized Pharm.D degree holder shall also be eligible for the posts
of Associate Professor in the subjects of Pathophysiology, Pharmacology and
Pharmacy practice.
iii) Three (3) Years of experience in teaching or research at the level of Assistant
Professor or equivalent in PCI approved/recognized Pharmacy college.
Desired Specializations:
Pharmaceutics/Pharmacology/ Pharmaceutical Chemistry/
Pharmacognosy/ Pharmaceutical Vigilance/ or any other relevant
specialization.
Essential Qualification :
1. A basic degree in Pharmacy ( B.Pharm ).
2. Registration as a pharmacist under the Pharmacy
Act, 1948, as amended from time to time, including any
succeeding enactments.
3. First Class Master’s Degree in appropriate branch of
specialization in Pharmacy.
Desired Qualification:
1. Teaching, research industrial and / or professional
experience in a reputed organization; and
2. Papers presented at Conferences and / or in refereed
journals.
